# Temml

The chat app's math, TeX to MathML, as published and unchanged:

- `temml.mjs`, `Temml-Latin-Modern.css` and `Temml.woff2`: Temml 0.13.5, from npm's
  `temml-0.13.5.tgz`, under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.
- `latinmodernmath.woff2`: Latin Modern Math 1.959, from Temml's repository at commit
  `9784bd5a7d615fb23fd3ae54dba1a0b0e376296c`, `site/assets/`, under the GUST Font License in
  `GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt`. Browsers' own math fonts differ, and some systems have none.
